# Azari Solar

> Azari Solar installs affordable solar panel systems for residential and commercial properties in Bohol and across the Philippines. Based in Tagbilaran City, Bohol.

## Pages

- [Home](https://azari.solar/): Overview of solar services, client testimonials, savings calculator, and project showcase
- [Packages](https://azari.solar/packages): Solar system packages — Hybrid, Grid-Tie, and Off-Grid — with pricing and specifications
- [Projects](https://azari.solar/projects): Gallery of completed solar installations across the Philippines
- [Client Journey](https://azari.solar/client-journey): Map and testimonials from clients who have installed solar with Azari
- [Solar Calculator](https://azari.solar/solar-calculator): Free tool to estimate solar savings based on monthly electricity bill

## Contact

- Phone: +63-961-618-3465
- Location: Tagbilaran City, Bohol, Philippines
- Service area: Bohol, Visayas, and nationwide Philippines

## Services

- Hybrid solar systems (with battery backup)
- Grid-tied (on-grid) solar systems with Net-Metering
- Off-grid solar systems
- 25-year panel warranty, certified PEE engineering, turnkey installation
